blocks.text: O'zbek tilida ishni o'zimiz qilmasdan, boshqaga **qildirganimizni** fe'lning o'zi ko'rsatadi — orttirma nisbat qo'shimchasi **-tir / -dir / -t**: sochimni **oldim** (o'zim) — sochimni **ol-dir-dim** (sartarosh oldi); mashinamni **tuzatdim** — mashinamni **tuzat-tir-dim** (usta tuzatdi). Ingliz tilida bunday qo'shimcha yo'q, uning o'rniga butun bir qolip ishlatiladi: **have + narsa + V3**. I **had my hair cut** — Sochimni **oldirdim**. Bu ikki tilning eng aniq mos keladigan joylaridan biri: o'zbekcha «-tir / -dir / -t» ni ko'rsangiz, inglizchada deyarli doim **have something done** kerak.

rows: I cut my hair. / I **had my hair cut**.
I repaired the car. / I **had the car repaired**.
I made a dress. / I **had a dress made**.
We painted the house. / We **had the house painted**.
I took a photo. / I **had my photo taken**.

blocks.text: Tartib juda muhim: **have** → **narsa** → **V3**. Agar V3 narsadan oldin kelsa, butunlay boshqa zamon chiqadi: I **had my car repaired** — mashinamni tuzattirdim (usta tuzatdi); I **had repaired** my car — Past Perfect: mashinamni (o'zim) tuzatib bo'lgan edim. Bu qolipdagi **have** — oddiy asosiy fe'l, shuning uchun u har qanday zamonda tuslanadi, so'roq va inkorda esa **do / does / did** oladi: Where **do** you **have** your hair cut? (Where have you your hair cut ✗).

rows: I**'m going to have** my watch **repaired**.

items.text: I **have** my car **serviced** every autumn before the cold weather.
items.translation: Har kuzda sovuq tushishidan oldin mashinamni **ko'rikdan o'tkazaman**.

items.text: We**'re having** a new front door **fitted** today.

blocks.text: So'zlashuvda **have** o'rniga ko'pincha **get** ishlatiladi, ma'no deyarli bir xil va so'z tartibi ham o'sha: **get + narsa + V3**. get ko'proq ishni **bajartirish uchun harakat qilish**, shoshilinchlik yoki qiyinchilik ohangini beradi: I must **get** my passport **renewed** — Pasportimni **yangilatishim** kerak (vaqt ozroq qoldi). Buyruq va maslahatlarda ham get juda tabiiy: **Get** that cough **checked**!

items.text: I really must **get** my watch **repaired** this week.
Can you **get** this letter **translated** by Monday?
Madina **got** her ears **pierced** when she was ten.

blocks.text: Kutilmagan noxush voqea: She had her bag stolen

**have something done** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — odamning boshiga **kelgan** (u buyurtma qilmagan, ko'pincha noxush) voqea: He **had his phone stolen** — Uning telefonini o'g'irlashdi. Qizig'i, o'zbekchada ham bu yerda orttirma nisbat ishlatiladi: «telefonini **o'g'irlatib qo'ydi**», «sumkasini **kesdirib qo'ydi**». Bu holatda harakatni boshqalar qiladi, lekin gap jabrlangan odam **haqida** bo'ladi — shuning uchun u ega bo'ladi.

items.text: Aziz **had his phone stolen** on the bus yesterday.
They **had their basement flooded** last spring.
I **had my bag searched** twice at the airport.

blocks.text: Odamni ham aytish kerak bo'lsa, ikki yo'l bor: **by** bilan — I had my suit made **by** a tailor in Bukhara; yoki **have + odam + fe'l** (asosan amerikancha, rasmiy): I'll **have** my assistant **call** you. — Yordamchimga sizga qo'ng'iroq qildiraman.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: sartaroshdan kelib «I cut my hair» deyish — bu «sochimni o'zim oldim» degani; to'g'risi: I **had my hair cut**; «I had cut my hair» → bu Past Perfect, tartib buzilgan: **had my hair cut**; «I repaired my car in the service» → I **had my car repaired** at the garage; «I made a photo» / «I took a photo» (o'zingiz rasmga tushgan bo'lsangiz) → I **had my photo taken**; «Where have you your hair cut?» → Where **do** you **have** your hair cut?

O'zbekcha fe'lda **-tir / -dir / -t** (oldirdim, tuzattirdim, tiktirdim, yuvdirdim) ko'rsangiz — **have + narsa + V3** yasang. Tartibni eslab qolish uchun: avval **kimniki** (my car), keyin **nima qilindi** (repaired) — «mashinam — tuzatilgan holda — menda bor».

rows: have — oddiy fe'l: barcha zamonlar, do / did bilan so'roq

examples.title: **had** my hair **cut**: services we pay for
examples.description: have + narsa + V3 — ishni o'zimiz emas, usta yoki xizmat qildi. O'zbekchada orttirma nisbat: oldirdim, tiktirdi, bo'yattirdik.

sentences.text: I **had my hair cut** yesterday at a new barber's near the metro.
sentences.translation: Kecha metro yaqinidagi yangi sartaroshxonada **sochimni oldirdim**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **had a dress made** for her sister's wedding by a dressmaker in Margilan.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza singlisining to'yi uchun Marg'ilondagi tikuvchiga ko'ylak **tiktirdi**.

sentences.text: We **had the whole flat painted** before the baby was born.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq tug'ilishidan oldin butun kvartirani **bo'yattirdik**.

sentences.text: Jasur **had his car repaired** at a garage, and it cost him a fortune.
sentences.translation: Jasur mashinasini ustaxonada **tuzattirdi**, bu unga juda qimmatga tushdi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **had a new kitchen fitted** last month — it looks amazing.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz o'tgan oy yangi oshxona jihozlarini **o'rnattirishdi** — ajoyib ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Before the trip, Emma **had her passport photos taken** at a little shop.
sentences.translation: Safardan oldin Emma kichik bir do'konda pasport uchun **suratga tushdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **had** a spare key **cut** for his new flatmate.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi xonadoshi uchun zaxira **kalit yasattirdi**.

sentences.text: The company **had all the computers checked** after the virus attack.
sentences.translation: Virus hujumidan keyin kompaniya barcha kompyuterlarni **tekshirtirdi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **had her old carpet cleaned** professionally, and now it looks new.
sentences.translation: Buvim eski gilamini mutaxassislarga **yuvdirdi**, endi u yangidek.

sentences.text: Rather than fix the roof themselves, Tom and Kate **had it done** by a local builder.
sentences.translation: Tom va Keyt tomni o'zlari tuzatish o'rniga, mahalliy ustaga **tuzattirishdi**.

examples.title: Myself or someone else? **cut** it / **had** it **cut**
examples.description: O'zim qildim — oddiy fe'l; boshqaga qildirdim — have + narsa + V3. O'zbekchada: o'rdim / o'rdirdim, yozdim / yozdirdim.

sentences.text: I usually **cut** the grass myself, but this summer I **had it cut** by a gardener.
sentences.translation: Odatda maysani o'zim **o'raman**, lekin bu yoz uni bog'bonga **o'rdirdim**.

sentences.text: Did you paint the walls yourself, or **did** you **have them painted**?
sentences.translation: Devorlarni o'zingiz bo'yadingizmi yoki **bo'yattirdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Nilufar didn't bake the cake herself — she **had it made** at a bakery.
sentences.translation: Nilufar tortni o'zi pishirmagan — uni qandolatxonada **pishirtirgan**.

sentences.text: My father **repairs** everything himself; he never **has anything repaired**.
sentences.translation: Otam hamma narsani o'zi **tuzatadi**, hech qachon hech narsani **tuzattirmaydi**.

sentences.text: Kate **had her nails done** at a salon, but her sister always does her own.
sentences.translation: Keyt tirnoqlarini salonda **bo'yattirdi**, singlisi esa doim o'zi bo'yaydi.

sentences.text: We can't move the piano ourselves, so we**'re having it moved** by professionals.
sentences.translation: Pianinoni o'zimiz ko'chira olmaymiz, shuning uchun uni mutaxassislarga **ko'chirtiryapmiz**.

sentences.text: Oliver translated the letter himself instead of **having it translated** — and made several mistakes.
sentences.translation: Oliver xatni **tarjima qildirish** o'rniga o'zi tarjima qildi va bir nechta xato qildi.

sentences.text: Do you cut your own hair? — No way! I **have it cut** every three weeks.
sentences.translation: Sochingizni o'zingiz olasizmi? — Yo'g'-e! Uni har uch haftada **oldiraman**.

sentences.text: Madina sewed the curtains by hand, but she **had the sofa re-covered** by an expert.
sentences.translation: Madina pardalarni qo'lda o'zi tikdi, divanni esa ustaga **qayta qoplattirdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah wanted to write the speech herself rather than **have it written** by an assistant.
sentences.translation: Sara nutqni yordamchiga **yozdirish** o'rniga o'zi yozmoqchi edi.

examples.title: All tenses: **are having** ... **done**, **'ve had** ... **done**
examples.description: have — oddiy fe'l, shuning uchun har qanday zamonda keladi: are having, have had, is going to have, had had.

sentences.text: We**'re having** our kitchen **renovated**, so we're eating out a lot.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamizni **ta'mirlatyapmiz**, shuning uchun ko'pincha tashqarida ovqatlanyapmiz.

sentences.text: You**'ve had** your hair **cut**! It really suits you.
sentences.translation: **Soch oldiribsiz**! Sizga juda yarashibdi.

sentences.text: I **have** my teeth **checked** twice a year, so I rarely have problems.
sentences.translation: Yiliga ikki marta **tishlarimni tekshirtiraman**, shuning uchun kamdan-kam muammo bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Madina **is going to have** her wedding dress **made** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madina to'y ko'ylagini Toshkentda **tiktirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: The hotel **was having** its pool **cleaned** when we arrived, so we couldn't swim.
sentences.translation: Biz kelganimizda mehmonxona basseynini **tozalatayotgan edi**, shuning uchun suza olmadik.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod **had** his visa **extended** yet, or is he still waiting?
sentences.translation: Bekzod vizasini **uzaytirtirdimi** yoki hali kutyaptimi?

sentences.text: Next week I**'ll have** the documents **translated** and send them to you.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta hujjatlarni **tarjima qildirib**, sizga yuboraman.

sentences.text: Sarah **had** her car **serviced** just before the long drive to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Sara Edinburgga uzoq yo'lga chiqishdan oldin mashinasini **ko'rikdan o'tkazdirdi**.

sentences.text: By the time we moved in, the owners **had had** the whole house **cleaned**.
sentences.translation: Biz ko'chib kirganimizda egalari butun uyni **tozalatib qo'ygan edi**.

sentences.text: They **have** the office windows **washed** every month, but they're still dirty.
sentences.translation: Ofis derazalarini har oy **yuvdirishadi**, lekin ular baribir iflos.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **Where do you have** ...?
examples.description: So'roq va inkor do / does / did bilan: Where do you have ...? Did you have ...? I didn't have ... Present Perfect da — have had.

sentences.text: Where **do** you **have** your hair **cut**? It always looks great.
sentences.translation: Sochingizni qayerda **oldirasiz**? Doim zo'r ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have** the brakes **checked** before the journey?
sentences.translation: Yo'lga chiqishdan oldin tormozlarni **tekshirtirdingizmi**?

sentences.text: How often **should** you **have** your eyes **tested**? — Every two years, I think.
sentences.translation: Ko'zni qanchalik tez-tez **tekshirtirish kerak**? — Menimcha, har ikki yilda.

sentences.text: We **didn't have** the carpets **cleaned**, so the flat still smells of smoke.
sentences.translation: Gilamlarni **yuvdirmadik**, shuning uchun kvartirada hali ham tutun hidi bor.

sentences.text: Why **don't** you **have** that old sofa **taken** away? It fills the whole room.
sentences.translation: Nega o'sha eski divanni **olib chiqib tashlatmaysiz**? Butun xonani egallab turibdi.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **had** your portrait **painted**? — Once, by a street artist in Paris.
sentences.translation: Hech portretingizni **chizdirganmisiz**? — Bir marta, Parijda ko'cha rassomiga.

sentences.text: Who **did** you **have** your suit **made** by? It fits perfectly.
sentences.translation: Kostyumingizni kimga **tiktirgansiz**? Juda yaxshi o'tiribdi.

sentences.text: I **haven't had** my phone **fixed** yet because the shop is closed this week.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni hali **tuzattirmadim**, chunki do'kon bu hafta yopiq.

sentences.text: Aziz **doesn't have** his shirts **ironed** at the laundry — his mother does them.
sentences.translation: Aziz ko'ylaklarini kir yuvish xizmatida **dazmollatmaydi** — onasi dazmollab beradi.

sentences.text: Isn't it time you **had** that tooth **looked at** by a dentist?
sentences.translation: O'sha tishni stomatologga **ko'rsatish** vaqti kelmadimi?

examples.title: **get** something **done**: informal and urgent
examples.description: get + narsa + V3 — have bilan bir xil ma'no, lekin so'zlashuvda; ko'pincha ishni bajartirish uchun harakat yoki shoshilinchlik bor.

sentences.text: I need to **get my passport renewed** before the summer holidays.
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'tilgacha **pasportimni yangilatishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Where can I **get** these photos **printed** quickly?
sentences.translation: Bu suratlarni qayerda tezda **chiqartirsam** bo'ladi?

sentences.text: Madina finally **got** her old laptop **fixed**, and it's working perfectly now.
sentences.translation: Madina nihoyat eski noutbukini **tuzattirdi**, endi u a'lo ishlayapti.

sentences.text: You should **get** that cough **checked** — it's been going on for weeks.
sentences.translation: O'sha yo'talni **shifokorga ko'rsatishing** kerak — haftalardan beri davom etyapti.

sentences.text: We **got** the new fridge **delivered** on the same day we ordered it.
sentences.translation: Yangi muzlatkichni buyurtma qilgan kunimizoq uyga **yetkazdirdik**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is getting** his car **washed** while he has lunch.
sentences.translation: Jasur tushlik qilayotganda mashinasini **yuvdiryapti**.

sentences.text: Did you **get** your essay **checked** by a native speaker?
sentences.translation: Inshoingizni ona tili ingliz bo'lgan odamga **tekshirtirdingizmi**?

sentences.text: It's almost impossible to **get** anything **done** in this office on a Friday afternoon.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni tushdan keyin bu ofisda biror ishni **bitkazish** deyarli imkonsiz.

sentences.text: Tom **is getting** a new fence **put up** around the garden next week.
sentences.translation: Tom kelasi hafta bog' atrofiga yangi to'siq **o'rnattirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: As soon as I **got** my visa **approved**, I booked a flight to London.
sentences.translation: Vizamni **tasdiqlatib olishim** bilanoq Londonga chipta band qildim.

examples.title: Advice and duties: **should have** it **checked**
examples.description: Modal fe'l + have / get + narsa + V3: maslahat, zarurat, imkon. O'zbekchada «tekshirtirish kerak», «tuzattirsa bo'ladi».

sentences.text: Your tyres look worn — you **should have them replaced** before winter.
sentences.translation: Shinalaringiz yeyilganga o'xshaydi — qishgacha ularni ustaxonada **almashtirtirishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Before you sell the flat, you**'ll need to get** it **valued** by an expert.
sentences.translation: Kvartirani sotishdan oldin uni mutaxassisga **baholatishingiz kerak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: The doctor told Nilufar to **have** her blood pressure **checked** every month.
sentences.translation: Shifokor Nilufarga qon bosimini har oy **tekshirtirib turishni** aytdi.

sentences.text: We **must get** the boiler **repaired** before the cold weather starts.
sentences.translation: Sovuq tushishidan oldin qozonni **tuzattirishimiz shart**.

sentences.text: If the jacket is too long, you **can have it shortened** at the tailor's next door.
sentences.translation: Kurtka uzunlik qilsa, uni qo'shnimizdagi tikuvchiga **kaltalatishingiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Kate wants **to get** her wedding photos **printed** and **framed**.
sentences.translation: Keyt to'y suratlarini **chiqartirib**, ramkaga **soldirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: You'd better **have** that wound **looked at** — it might be infected.
sentences.translation: O'sha jarohatni **shifokorga ko'rsatganingiz** ma'qul — infeksiya tushgan bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Why pay a fortune for a new one when you **could get** the old one **repaired**?
sentences.translation: Eskisini **tuzattirsangiz** bo'ladiyu, nega yangisiga katta pul to'laysiz?

sentences.text: All employees **have to have** their ID cards **renewed** every two years.
sentences.translation: Barcha xodimlar ID kartalarini har ikki yilda **yangilatishlari shart**.

sentences.text: Bekzod is thinking of **having** his old family photos **scanned** so that they don't get lost.
sentences.translation: Bekzod eski oilaviy suratlari yo'qolib ketmasligi uchun ularni **skanerlatishni** o'ylayapti.

examples.title: Bad experiences: **had** her bag **stolen**
examples.description: have + narsa + V3 — odamning boshiga kelgan, u istamagan voqea. O'zbekchada ham ko'pincha orttirma nisbat: o'g'irlatib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Emma **had her bag stolen** on the underground in London.
sentences.translation: Emma Londonda metroda **sumkasini o'g'irlatib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: Last year James **had his driving licence taken away** for speeding.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Jeymsdan tez haydagani uchun **haydovchilik guvohnomasini olib qo'yishdi**.

sentences.text: We **had our flight cancelled** at the last minute and spent the night at the airport.
sentences.translation: So'nggi daqiqada **reysimizni bekor qilishdi** va tunni aeroportda o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: Poor Aziz **had his nose broken** playing football on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Bechora Aziz shanba kuni futbol o'ynayotganda **burnini sindirib oldi**.

sentences.text: Several houses in the village **had their roofs blown off** in the storm.
sentences.translation: Bo'ronda qishloqdagi bir nechta uyning **tomini shamol uchirib ketdi**.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **had** your email account **hacked**?
sentences.translation: Hech elektron pochtangizni **buzib kirishganmi**?

sentences.text: Madina **had her phone snatched** from her hand while she was walking home.
sentences.translation: Madina uyga ketayotganida **telefonini qo'lidan yulib ketishdi**.

sentences.text: The café on our corner **had its windows broken** by vandals last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha bezorilar muyulishdagi **kafening derazalarini sindirib ketishdi**.

sentences.text: My brother **had his salary cut** when the company started losing money.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya zarar ko'ra boshlaganda akamning **maoshini qisqartirishdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **had his application rejected** twice before he was finally accepted.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat qabul qilinishidan oldin Tomning **arizasini** ikki marta **rad etishgan**.

examples.title: Dialogue: getting ready for a wedding
examples.description: Ikki dugona to'yga tayyorgarlik haqida gaplashadi: had it coloured, had one made, got it fixed, had his wallet stolen.

sentences.text: — Kate, you look different! **Have** you **had** your hair **done**?
sentences.translation: — Keyt, boshqacha ko'rinyapsan! **Sochingni turmaklatdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **had it coloured** this morning for my cousin's wedding.
sentences.translation: — Ha, amakivachchamning to'yi uchun bugun ertalab **bo'yattirdim**.

sentences.text: — It's lovely. **Are** you **having** a new dress **made** as well?
sentences.translation: — Juda chiroyli. Yangi ko'ylak ham **tiktiryapsanmi**?

sentences.text: — I**'ve** already **had one made** in Margilan, from real atlas silk.
sentences.translation: — Marg'ilonda haqiqiy atlasdan bittasini **tiktirib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: — And your car? You said you needed to **get** the air conditioning **fixed**.
sentences.translation: — Mashinang-chi? Konditsionerni **tuzattirishim kerak** degan eding.

sentences.text: — Oh, I **got it done** yesterday, so the drive to Samarkand will be comfortable.
sentences.translation: — Kecha **tuzattirdim**, Samarqandgacha yo'l qulay bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Great. By the way, did you hear that Tom **had his wallet stolen** at the station?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Aytgancha, Tom vokzalda **hamyonini o'g'irlatib qo'yganini** eshitdingmi?

sentences.text: — No! **Did** he **have** his cards **blocked** in time?
sentences.translation: — Yo'g'-e! Kartalarini o'z vaqtida **bloklatdimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, luckily. But he still needs to **get** a new ID card **made**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, baxtiga. Lekin hali yangi ID karta **qildirishi** kerak.

sentences.text: — Poor Tom! Let's **have** some flowers **sent** to him to cheer him up.
sentences.translation: — Bechora Tom! Kayfiyati ko'tarilishi uchun unga gul **yubortiraylik**.
